Welcome to BTS 2026 : The Global Stage for Technology, Innovation and Impact
The 29th edition of the Bengaluru Tech Summit will take place from 17–19 November 2026 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC) under the theme 'AI & Beyond'. As one of Asia’s premier technology gatherings, the summit showcases Karnataka and Bengaluru as global centres of innovation- bringing together industry leaders, researchers, startups, investors and policymakers from around the world.
While spotlighting the transformative power of artificial intelligence, BTS 2026 will also explore the broader frontier of emerging technologies shaping the next era of global progress, from deep tech and advanced digital ecosystems to breakthrough scientific and industrial innovation. As a global platform for dialogue, discovery and collaboration, the summit continues to amplify Karnataka’s leadership in technology while connecting the world to the ideas shaping tomorrow.
Join us in Bengaluru as the world gathers to imagine, innovate and build the future.

Asia’s Premier Tech Commerce & Innovation Marketplace 
The Exhibition at BTS 2026 will be about conversions. Conversions of ideas into ventures. Conversations into partnerships. Product Demos to Deals. Set against the expansive backdrop of BIEC, this year’s exhibition promises a bold new scale, spotlighting innovation, collaboration, and commerce. With a major leap in participation, floor area, and international representation, the exhibition is set to become the business engine of the summit. It will host 1,600+ exhibitors from across India and from over 60 countries, representing diverse sectors and cutting-edge technologies.

## Welcome to BTS 2026 : The Global Stage for Technology, Innovation and Impact

The **29th edition of the Bengaluru Tech Summit** will take place from **17–19 November 2026** at the **Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC)** under the theme '**AI & Beyond**'. As one of Asia’s premier technology gatherings, the summit showcases Karnataka and Bengaluru as global centres of innovation- bringing together industry leaders, researchers, startups, investors and policymakers from around the world.

While spotlighting the transformative power of artificial intelligence, **BTS 2026** will also explore the broader frontier of emerging technologies shaping the next era of global progress, from deep tech and advanced digital ecosystems to breakthrough scientific and industrial innovation. As a global platform for dialogue, discovery and collaboration, the summit continues to amplify Karnataka’s leadership in technology while connecting the world to the ideas shaping tomorrow.

Join us in Bengaluru as the world gathers to **imagine, innovate and build the future.**

## Game-Changing Business @ BTS Exhibition

#### Asia’s Premier Tech Commerce & Innovation Marketplace

The Exhibition at BTS 2026 will be about conversions. Conversions of ideas into ventures. Conversations into partnerships. Product Demos to Deals. Set against the expansive backdrop of BIEC, this year’s exhibition promises a bold new scale, spotlighting innovation, collaboration, and commerce. With a major leap in participation, floor area, and international representation, the exhibition is set to become the business engine of the summit. It will host 1,600+ exhibitors from across India and from over 60 countries, representing diverse sectors and cutting-edge technologies.

Conference @ BTS 2026 | Bengaluru Tech Summit
Igniting Futurise
As we stand at the edge of an era defined by exponential technologies and global urgency, the Conference at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2025 embodies the spirit of FutuRise - a call to rise beyond boundaries, ideate with purpose, and build future-ready societies.
Over 3 power-packed days, the conference will host 8 thematic tracks, 600+ global speakers, 100+ deep-dive sessions, and thought leadership dialogues that spotlight the power of technology across sectors and societies. From AI and semiconductors to healthtech and climate tech to global policy, this is where conversations shape the contours of tomorrow.
Igniting Futurise
Building on the momentum of the recently concluded Bengaluru Tech Summit 2025, which brought together global leaders, innovators, and policymakers from across the world, the Conference at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 sets the stage for the next chapter of technology-led transformation. As we move deeper into an era defined by exponential technologies, shifting global dynamics, and urgent societal challenges, the Conference embodies the spirit of Futurise, a call to rise beyond boundaries, ideate with purpose, and build future-ready, resilient societies.
Over three power-packed days, the Conference at BTS 2026 will convene a dynamic programme featuring multiple thematic tracks, global thought leaders, and deep-dive sessions that explore the intersection of technology, policy, and impact. From artificial intelligence and semiconductors to digital public infrastructure, healthtech, climate innovation, and frontier science, the Conference will serve as a platform where ideas evolve into action and conversations shape the contours of tomorrow.
Session Formats 
Keynote Sessions by global industry pioneers and visionaries
Fireside Chats that bring out candid insights from top leaders 
Panel Discussions with experts debating the trends, opportunities, and road ahead 
Masterclasses & Special Talks offering deep-dives and skill-building 
Roundtables designed for private, high-impact peer discussions 
Who Will You Hear From? 
Global CEOs & CTOs from Global companies
Deeptech Founders & Unicorn Builders
Ministers, Secretaries & Policymakers from India and abroad
Venture Capitalists, LPs, and Family Offices
Academics & Researchers from leading global Universities, institutions and Labs
Innovators & Inventors at the frontier of emerging tech
Startup Founders across various tech sectors
Thought Leaders & Insights
Why You Should Attend the BTS 2026 Conference
Witness the convergence of business, tech, and societal impact 
Gain foresight from AI, deeptech, and global digital leaders 
Explore new partnerships with startups, corporations, and countries 
Participate in powerful conversations shaping the decade ahead 
Discover emerging trends across sectors and geographies 
Expand your network with curated sessions and B2B meetings 
Thematic Tracks
Powering Innovation Across Emerging Sectors
IT & Deeptech
Exploring the latest trends in AI, next-gen computing, quantum technologies, and advanced digital architectures while addressing critical policy frameworks, global tech realignments and macroeconomic shifts shaping the intelligent enterprise era. 
Frontier Tech
Exploring breakthroughs in AI, aerospace, robotics, advanced manufacturing, Web3 and advanced materials shaping tomorrow’s industries. 
Embedded World India, co-located with BTS 2026, focuses on electronics, semiconductors, and advanced embedded technologies, enabling collaboration and insights into intelligent, connected systems. 
Electric Mobility
Focused on the EV revolution and startups redefining the mobility sector and ecosystem. 
Health & Biotech
Transforming healthcare through AI-enabled diagnostics, precision medicine, biotech breakthroughs, and digital health innovation. 
Digital Infrastructure & Data Centers
Enabling India’s next-generation hyperscale, sustainable and edge-enabled infrastructure to power the country’s AI-driven digital future. 
Data & Cybersecurity
Exploring AI-driven threat intelligence, robust data governance, privacy frameworks and cyber resilience strategies. 
Assistive Tech
This track explores innovations that enhance accessibility, independence and quality of life for persons with disabilities through showcase of technologies and dialogue. 
Focus GCC
Exploring transformation of GCCs into AI-driven centres of innovation, product ownership, advanced engineering and global digital leadership. 
Circular Economy
Leveraging technology and AI to enable sustainable production, resource efficiency and climate-smart industrial systems. 
Orange Economy
Powering creative and cultural industries through digital platforms, immersive tech, AI-enabled content and innovation in media & design. 
Finverse
Reimagining financial ecosystems and spotlighting innovative startups driving the future of finance. 
Skilling & Edutech
The current learning systems must evolve to prepare talent for a rapidly changing technology landscape. This track focuses on building a future-ready workforce equipped for emerging technologies and new-age industries. 
India-USA Tech Conclave
Strengthening strategic tech partnerships for critical and emerging technologies. 
Global Collaborations
Curated sessions fostering cross-border innovation alliances, investment flows, and strategic partnerships for shared global growth. 
India Innovates
Showcasing breakthrough grassroots innovation and startups solving national and global challenges with scalable tech solutions.

Conference @ BTS 2026 | Bengaluru Tech Summit
Igniting Futurise
As we stand at the edge of an era defined by exponential technologies and global urgency, the Conference at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2025 embodies the spirit of FutuRise - a call to rise beyond boundaries, ideate with purpose, and build future-ready societies.
Over 3 power-packed days, the conference will host 8 thematic tracks, 600+ global speakers, 100+ deep-dive sessions, and thought leadership dialogues that spotlight the power of technology across sectors and societies. From AI and semiconductors to healthtech and climate tech to global policy, this is where conversations shape the contours of tomorrow.
Igniting Futurise
Building on the momentum of the recently concluded Bengaluru Tech Summit 2025, which brought together global leaders, innovators, and policymakers from across the world, the Conference at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 sets the stage for the next chapter of technology-led transformation. As we move deeper into an era defined by exponential technologies, shifting global dynamics, and urgent societal challenges, the Conference embodies the spirit of Futurise, a call to rise beyond boundaries, ideate with purpose, and build future-ready, resilient societies.
Over three power-packed days, the Conference at BTS 2026 will convene a dynamic programme featuring multiple thematic tracks, global thought leaders, and deep-dive sessions that explore the intersection of technology, policy, and impact. From artificial intelligence and semiconductors to digital public infrastructure, healthtech, climate innovation, and frontier science, the Conference will serve as a platform where ideas evolve into action and conversations shape the contours of tomorrow.
Session Formats 
Keynote Sessions by global industry pioneers and visionaries
Fireside Chats that bring out candid insights from top leaders 
Panel Discussions with experts debating the trends, opportunities, and road ahead 
Masterclasses & Special Talks offering deep-dives and skill-building 
Roundtables designed for private, high-impact peer discussions 
Who Will You Hear From? 
Global CEOs & CTOs from Global companies
Deeptech Founders & Unicorn Builders
Ministers, Secretaries & Policymakers from India and abroad
Venture Capitalists, LPs, and Family Offices
Academics & Researchers from leading global Universities, institutions and Labs
Innovators & Inventors at the frontier of emerging tech
Startup Founders across various tech sectors
Thought Leaders & Insights
Why You Should Attend the BTS 2026 Conference
Witness the convergence of business, tech, and societal impact 
Gain foresight from AI, deeptech, and global digital leaders 
Explore new partnerships with startups, corporations, and countries 
Participate in powerful conversations shaping the decade ahead 
Discover emerging trends across sectors and geographies 
Expand your network with curated sessions and B2B meetings 
Thematic Tracks
Powering Innovation Across Emerging Sectors
IT & Deeptech
Exploring the latest trends in AI, next-gen computing, quantum technologies, and advanced digital architectures while addressing critical policy frameworks, global tech realignments and macroeconomic shifts shaping the intelligent enterprise era. 
Frontier Tech
Exploring breakthroughs in AI, aerospace, robotics, advanced manufacturing, Web3 and advanced materials shaping tomorrow’s industries. 
Embedded World India, co-located with BTS 2026, focuses on electronics, semiconductors, and advanced embedded technologies, enabling collaboration and insights into intelligent, connected systems. 
Electric Mobility
Focused on the EV revolution and startups redefining the mobility sector and ecosystem. 
Health & Biotech
Transforming healthcare through AI-enabled diagnostics, precision medicine, biotech breakthroughs, and digital health innovation. 
Digital Infrastructure & Data Centers
Enabling India’s next-generation hyperscale, sustainable and edge-enabled infrastructure to power the country’s AI-driven digital future. 
Data & Cybersecurity
Exploring AI-driven threat intelligence, robust data governance, privacy frameworks and cyber resilience strategies. 
Assistive Tech
This track explores innovations that enhance accessibility, independence and quality of life for persons with disabilities through showcase of technologies and dialogue. 
Focus GCC
Exploring transformation of GCCs into AI-driven centres of innovation, product ownership, advanced engineering and global digital leadership. 
Circular Economy
Leveraging technology and AI to enable sustainable production, resource efficiency and climate-smart industrial systems. 
Orange Economy
Powering creative and cultural industries through digital platforms, immersive tech, AI-enabled content and innovation in media & design. 
Finverse
Reimagining financial ecosystems and spotlighting innovative startups driving the future of finance. 
Skilling & Edutech
The current learning systems must evolve to prepare talent for a rapidly changing technology landscape. This track focuses on building a future-ready workforce equipped for emerging technologies and new-age industries. 
India-USA Tech Conclave
Strengthening strategic tech partnerships for critical and emerging technologies. 
Global Collaborations
Curated sessions fostering cross-border innovation alliances, investment flows, and strategic partnerships for shared global growth. 
India Innovates
Showcasing breakthrough grassroots innovation and startups solving national and global challenges with scalable tech solutions.

Conference @ BTS 2026 | Bengaluru Tech Summit
Igniting Futurise
As we stand at the edge of an era defined by exponential technologies and global urgency, the Conference at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2025 embodies the spirit of FutuRise - a call to rise beyond boundaries, ideate with purpose, and build future-ready societies.
Over 3 power-packed days, the conference will host 8 thematic tracks, 600+ global speakers, 100+ deep-dive sessions, and thought leadership dialogues that spotlight the power of technology across sectors and societies. From AI and semiconductors to healthtech and climate tech to global policy, this is where conversations shape the contours of tomorrow.
Igniting Futurise
Building on the momentum of the recently concluded Bengaluru Tech Summit 2025, which brought together global leaders, innovators, and policymakers from across the world, the Conference at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 sets the stage for the next chapter of technology-led transformation. As we move deeper into an era defined by exponential technologies, shifting global dynamics, and urgent societal challenges, the Conference embodies the spirit of Futurise, a call to rise beyond boundaries, ideate with purpose, and build future-ready, resilient societies.
Over three power-packed days, the Conference at BTS 2026 will convene a dynamic programme featuring multiple thematic tracks, global thought leaders, and deep-dive sessions that explore the intersection of technology, policy, and impact. From artificial intelligence and semiconductors to digital public infrastructure, healthtech, climate innovation, and frontier science, the Conference will serve as a platform where ideas evolve into action and conversations shape the contours of tomorrow.
Session Formats 
Keynote Sessions by global industry pioneers and visionaries
Fireside Chats that bring out candid insights from top leaders 
Panel Discussions with experts debating the trends, opportunities, and road ahead 
Masterclasses & Special Talks offering deep-dives and skill-building 
Roundtables designed for private, high-impact peer discussions 
Who Will You Hear From? 
Global CEOs & CTOs from Global companies
Deeptech Founders & Unicorn Builders
Ministers, Secretaries & Policymakers from India and abroad
Venture Capitalists, LPs, and Family Offices
Academics & Researchers from leading global Universities, institutions and Labs
Innovators & Inventors at the frontier of emerging tech
Startup Founders across various tech sectors
Thought Leaders & Insights
Why You Should Attend the BTS 2026 Conference
Witness the convergence of business, tech, and societal impact 
Gain foresight from AI, deeptech, and global digital leaders 
Explore new partnerships with startups, corporations, and countries 
Participate in powerful conversations shaping the decade ahead 
Discover emerging trends across sectors and geographies 
Expand your network with curated sessions and B2B meetings 
Thematic Tracks
Powering Innovation Across Emerging Sectors
IT & Deeptech
Exploring the latest trends in AI, next-gen computing, quantum technologies, and advanced digital architectures while addressing critical policy frameworks, global tech realignments and macroeconomic shifts shaping the intelligent enterprise era. 
Frontier Tech
Exploring breakthroughs in AI, aerospace, robotics, advanced manufacturing, Web3 and advanced materials shaping tomorrow’s industries. 
Embedded World India, co-located with BTS 2026, focuses on electronics, semiconductors, and advanced embedded technologies, enabling collaboration and insights into intelligent, connected systems. 
Electric Mobility
Focused on the EV revolution and startups redefining the mobility sector and ecosystem. 
Health & Biotech
Transforming healthcare through AI-enabled diagnostics, precision medicine, biotech breakthroughs, and digital health innovation. 
Digital Infrastructure & Data Centers
Enabling India’s next-generation hyperscale, sustainable and edge-enabled infrastructure to power the country’s AI-driven digital future. 
Data & Cybersecurity
Exploring AI-driven threat intelligence, robust data governance, privacy frameworks and cyber resilience strategies. 
Assistive Tech
This track explores innovations that enhance accessibility, independence and quality of life for persons with disabilities through showcase of technologies and dialogue. 
Focus GCC
Exploring transformation of GCCs into AI-driven centres of innovation, product ownership, advanced engineering and global digital leadership. 
Circular Economy
Leveraging technology and AI to enable sustainable production, resource efficiency and climate-smart industrial systems. 
Orange Economy
Powering creative and cultural industries through digital platforms, immersive tech, AI-enabled content and innovation in media & design. 
Finverse
Reimagining financial ecosystems and spotlighting innovative startups driving the future of finance. 
Skilling & Edutech
The current learning systems must evolve to prepare talent for a rapidly changing technology landscape. This track focuses on building a future-ready workforce equipped for emerging technologies and new-age industries. 
India-USA Tech Conclave
Strengthening strategic tech partnerships for critical and emerging technologies. 
Global Collaborations
Curated sessions fostering cross-border innovation alliances, investment flows, and strategic partnerships for shared global growth. 
India Innovates
Showcasing breakthrough grassroots innovation and startups solving national and global challenges with scalable tech solutions.
